Tools

Free Shortwave Tools

Free calculators and live tools for shortwave listeners. They run in your browser; nothing to install, no sign-up.

Dipole Antenna CalculatorFree dipole calculator: enter a frequency or pick a shortwave band to get the total length and each leg in feet and metres.Longwire Antenna Length CalculatorFind random-wire antenna lengths that avoid half-wave resonance on the shortwave broadcast bands. For 9:1 unun longwires.Frequency to Wavelength ConverterConvert kHz or MHz to wavelength in metres and find the shortwave meter band, or convert wavelength back to frequency.UTC Time Converter for Shortwave SchedulesConvert shortwave schedule times from UTC to your local time (or back), with daylight saving handled automatically.Live Grey Line MapLive grey line map showing where it is sunrise and sunset right now, plus your local sunrise and sunset times for DX listening.My ScheduleSave your favourite stations and see what's on next, in your local time.Printable Schedule CardsPrint a pocket schedule for any station or language, in your time zone.Radio Comparison ToolCompare the specs of any two shortwave radios side by side.
